summary.intent: Extract shared-folder write operations from the web UI's useSharedNavigation hook into stateless SDK functions, then refactor the web UI hooks to use the SDK as thin wrappers, with comprehensive test coverage.
summary.outcome: A GSD quick task (260327-2ab) was planned and execution was initiated. The planner produced a PLAN.md and an executor agent was spawned to implement the extraction.

repo: The SDK currently only supports the owner's perspective for share operations (shareFolder, revokeShare, reWrapForRecipients); the recipient's write path was entirely in the web UI.
The web UI useSharedNavigation hook contains ~400 lines of framework-agnostic crypto/IPFS/IPNS business logic tangled with React state.
publishSharedFolderMetadata is the recipient-side counterpart to the SDK's updateFolderMetadataAndPublish — uses a re-wrapped IPNS key instead of the owner's key.
The SDK's ShareCallbacks type uses 'file' | 'folder' but the web UI has widened this to 'file-ipns' | 'folder-ipns' — a type mismatch that needs fixing.
withRevocationGuard and isForbiddenError (line ~761 and ~140 of useSharedNavigation.ts) implement a 403-detection pattern needed by any SDK consumer doing shared writes.
uint8ToBase64 helper already exists in sdk-core as a utility — the web UI has a duplicate.

code.finding: publishSharedFolderMetadata — recipient-side equivalent of SDK's updateFolderMetadataAndPublish; encrypts folder metadata, uploads to IPFS, publishes IPNS record using re-wrapped key.
withRevocationGuard wraps write operations to detect 403 responses and transition UI to read-only; should be part of SDK's shared-write path.
isForbiddenError — helper used by revocation guard to detect 403s.
refreshFolderContents — resolves IPNS, decrypts folder metadata, returns children + sequence number; shared-folder variant of sdk-core's fetchAndDecryptMetadata.
updateSharePermission wraps sharesControllerUpdatePermission — natural addition to SDK's share module alongside createShare/revokeShare.
Fire-and-forget reWrapForRecipients call after file update — this pattern should be baked into SDK's write path rather than left to UI hooks.

workflow: GSD quick task IDs use YYMMDD-xxx format with 2s Base36 precision for uniqueness.
The analysis phase (identifying SDK candidates) was done manually before invoking /gsd:quick, with the full context passed in the --context argument.
The planner was spawned in standard quick mode (not --full), so no plan-checker or post-execution verifier was used.

friction: The executor agent was spawned but the transcript ends before its result is known — outcome of the implementation is not confirmed.
Multiple redundant Read tool calls on the same tool-result file (bd7c24hx3.txt read 5 times) suggests the diff output was too large to read in one pass.
open_items: Confirm executor completed successfully and 260327-2ab-SUMMARY.md was created.
Verify ShareCallbacks type in SDK is widened from 'file' | 'folder' to 'file-ipns' | 'folder-ipns'.
Remove duplicate uint8ToBase64 from web UI after SDK extraction.
The 'moderate candidate' restoreIpnsKeyForDepth was noted but not included in the extraction scope — the key-unwrapping portion could still become an SDK helper.
The reWrapForRecipients pattern (call after any mutation) should be evaluated for inclusion in the SDK's write path in a follow-up.
30s polling effect in useSharedNavigation is UI-specific and was explicitly excluded — no action needed unless a non-React consumer needs polling.
